normalizerFacts: RewriteCall calls ChangedArguments only with plan.explicitIds and excludes majorId; every other walk only concatenates those changes.
generalizedIds can contain duplicates from distinct recursive calls. Their exact order and repetition are retained.
parameterIds come from all actual typed source binders; explicitIds are the explicit subset. Set membership avoids quadratic host assertions.
BuildNormalizationWithOrigin always constructs forallE workerType and matchE workerValue and retains the fixed binder subset.
Successful normalized declaration batches are exactly [definition worker, definition publicWrapper].
Stable data batches contain the actual type, constructors, recursor in actual preparation order; they do not invent separate projection declarations.
limits: Keep existing raw input text, module-input length 1024, source-option checks, and original-IR carrier checks unchanged.
Origin source declaration lists use the actual sourcePolicy.stats.declarationCount.
Parameter, explicit, and generalized ID lists use actual sourcePolicy.stats.visitedSteps.

Prepared Core list uses min(MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, syntaxSteps + 2 * sourceDeclarationCount); stable value batches have one member, normalized value batches two, and data batches have type/recursor plus explicitly visited constructors.
Declaration/Core names no longer inherit the unrelated 1024 module-name cap. Owned list/Core-name walks detect cycles.
Numeric Core-name components remain arbitrary nonnegative bigint decimal strings, without Number conversion.
The worker-syntax visitor uses a visited-object Set over the already constructed compiler-owned graph; no origin-only default numeric cap is added.
This is post-emission observation of source-owned results, not admission of arbitrary caller graphs or a global wall-clock/heap guarantee.

nameComponent: exact string or unsigned decimal string
sourceOriginsSchema.identifierArrays: Unsigned decimal strings preserve actual retained IDs, including repeated generalized IDs.
sourceOriginsSchema.generatedDigest: SHA-256 over UTF-8 JSON.stringify(common ordered sourceOrigins fields), without newline and excluding generated-only trailing fields.
sourceOriginsSchema.nativeDigest: Native serializes exactly the common ordered payload using psJsonObject/psJsonArray. Root's binder must hash its reconstructed common JSON payload and compare with generated observationsSha256; Lean does not fabricate a digest.

diagnostics.detailDifference: Native detail uses existing psHostElabErrorText; generated detail uses the actual PsElabError variant tag. These human diagnostic details are not an asserted native/generated byte-equality surface.

capabilityFacts.implicitAndProofBinders: sh1ReverseInto and sh1WithProof assert explicit parameter positions and fixed binder retention from actual typed IDs.

capabilityFacts.historicalStableMode: Existing explicitly requested stable-mode diagnostic remains separate and unchanged.
capabilityFacts.negativeStoredSpans: All six negatives assert exact start and stop positions from authored token/tail metadata, including existing ParseLean grouping-span behavior.
